scenes.justification: hook: novice asks how an airline hedges 2M gallons of jet fuel without direct contracts, mentor frames cross hedging with NYMEX heating oil

beats.visualIntent: Novice question message card on hedging 2M gallons commercial jet fuel without direct exchange contracts
Mentor response comparing Part 1 identical asset crude oil baseline against real-world commodity mismatches
Cross hedging definition card showing commercial airline hedging jet fuel using NYMEX heating oil futures
Quantitative challenge card introducing Minimum Variance Hedge Ratio formula to protect non-standard assets

scenes.justification: formula: mathematical derivation of h* = rho * (sigma_S / sigma_F) and contract count N*

beats.visualIntent: Formula banner displaying optimal Minimum Variance Hedge Ratio formula: h* = rho * (sigma_S / sigma_F)
Variable breakdown callouts: correlation rho between delta S and delta F, spot sigma_S, and futures sigma_F
Intuitive volatility ratio graphic showing how higher futures volatility sigma_F > sigma_S drives h* below 1.0
Contract sizing formula card displaying N* = h* * (Q_A / Q_F) scaling by physical size Q_A and contract size Q_F

scenes.justification: worked_example: airline hedging 2M gallons jet fuel with NYMEX heating oil 42,000-gallon contracts

beats.visualIntent: Airline problem setup card: 2,000,000 gallons jet fuel in 1 month cross-hedged with NYMEX heating oil futures
Historical parameters block: spot sigma_S = 0.0263, futures sigma_F = 0.0313, correlation rho = 0.928
Calculation card: h* = 0.78, contract count N* = 37.14 rounded to 37 NYMEX 42,000-gallon contracts

scenes.justification: comparison: contrasts theoretical forward contracts with futures daily marking to market and tailing

beats.visualIntent: Split contrast between theoretical forward contracts lump-sum settlement and futures daily marking-to-market margin flows
Tailing the hedge card explaining interest rate discounting on daily margin and estimating h* from percentage returns
Tailed contract sizing formula resolution card: N* = h* * (V_A / V_F) using total dollar values

scenes.justification: formula: stock index futures portfolio immunization N* = beta * (V_A / V_F) and tactical beta steering

beats.visualIntent: Equity portfolio dilemma display: institutional multi-million dollar equity portfolio facing macroeconomic crash
Stock index futures formula card: N* = beta * (V_A / V_F) shorting S and P 500 futures to immunize market risk
Formula variable breakdown: beta systematic sensitivity, P total portfolio market value, and A futures contract value
Operational advantages card: slashing transaction costs, avoiding tax realization, and preserving stock selection

scenes.justification: process: five-node causal chain demonstrating tactical beta steering under severe market downturn

beats.visualIntent: Dynamic beta steering concept: market risk definition as market-wide volatility and adjusting portfolio sensitivity
Defensive beta reduction: shorting N* = (beta - beta*) * (P / A) index contracts to cut beta and cushion downturns
Aggressive beta amplification: going long index futures with negative short formula position to amplify rally exposure

scenes.justification: pillars: three progressive cards decomposing individual stock risk, alpha isolation, and multi-year hedging

beats.visualIntent: Card 1: Risk decomposition separating stock risk into systematic market volatility and unsystematic earnings potential
Card 2: Alpha isolation mechanism stripping broad index market swings with index futures to isolate stock selection
Card 3: Stack and roll bridge for multi-year corporate exposures when long-dated futures lack liquidity

scenes.justification: table: structured matrix comparing Stack and Roll versus Strip Hedge on maturity, liquidity, and rollover risk

beats.visualIntent: Maturity mismatch comparison row: 5-to-10 year corporate supply commitments versus short-dated liquid futures
Stack and Roll strategy row: concentrated front-month futures volume rolled forward periodically
Rollover basis risk row: persistent cash losses and margin calls in contango versus backwardation gains

scenes.justification: quiz: interactive scenario calculating optimal hedge ratio h* from given statistical parameters

beats.visualIntent: Scenario question card: spot sigma_S = 0.040, futures sigma_F = 0.050, correlation rho = 0.80, prompt for h*
Thinking pause card with 4 options (A: 0.50, B: 0.64, C: 0.80, D: 1.00) and formula hint h* = rho * (sigma_S / sigma_F)
Solution reveal card highlighting Option B 0.64, showing 0.80 * (0.040 / 0.050) = 0.64 hedging 64% variance
